requirement: The error page offers Reintentar
expected: Reintentar asks the server for the page again and re-renders it in place; the address stays and a passing failure clears.
steps: Open it, press Reintentar after the failure clears.

requirement: A slow page change shows the top bar
expected: A tap that changes the page shows a thin bar after 100 ms and it finishes when the new page arrives; a faster change shows nothing.
preconditions: Network throttled to Slow 4G; then unthrottled.
steps: Open a listing from the catalog both ways.

requirement: A page slower than a second shows its skeleton
expected: After 1 s a listing, store page or the account (arriving from outside it) shows its skeleton over the old page, below the header; Atrás returns to the same scroll position.
preconditions: Network throttled so a page takes over a second.
steps: Open a listing, a store page and Mi cuenta from the home; go back.

requirement: Screen readers hear a slow page change
expected: After 1 s a polite status says "Cargando la página…" once; it clears when the page arrives.
steps: Open a listing from the catalog.

requirement: Only taps that change Laria's page start the feedback
expected: A heart inside a card, another site, a new tab, a download, a file, an API route or a #section on the same page start no bar.
steps: Tap each kind of control.

requirement: No route has a loading file
expected: No loading.tsx exists under app/ (owner decision Q1 A), and catalog filter changes always commit.
steps: List loading files; change filters several times in a row.

requirement: Data saving asks for smaller images
expected: With Save-Data or a 3G connection, images that appear after the page loads request about 1.5 device pixels per CSS pixel from the same srcset.
preconditions: Chrome with 3G throttling or the phone's data saver on.
steps: Open the catalog, scroll to load more results, open a gallery.

requirement: Data saving loads no page ahead of time
expected: With Save-Data or a slow connection, cards do not prefetch the listing page, on view or on hover.
steps: Watch the network panel on the catalog.

requirement: An image is never downloaded twice when data saving changes
expected: The size is fixed at the image's first render; images the server sent stay as they are.
preconditions: Data saving turned on after the page loaded.
steps: Toggle the throttling on a loaded page.

requirement: Every gesture has a button
expected: The gallery has thumbnails and arrows; the lightbox has Foto anterior, Foto siguiente, Acercar and Alejar; photo order has Mover foto antes and después.
preconditions: A listing with several photos; the sell form with photos.
steps: Use each without swiping, pinching or dragging.

requirement: A bottom bar never covers the focused field
expected: Tabbing through Inventario with the bulk bar open, the catalog with the comparison tray, a page with the alert prompt or Deshacer, and a listing on a phone keeps the focused element above the bar; the footer ends above the contact bar.
steps: Open each bar, tab through the page.

requirement: Touch targets are at least 24 px
expected: axe target-size passes on every page, including the inventory table's row links; phones have a visible Seleccionar todos.
steps: Run the page audit.

requirement: Changes are announced to screen readers
expected: Guardado on favorites, the photo summary while uploading and the catalog's result count are read as they change, without moving focus.
steps: Save a favorite, add photos in the sell form, apply a filter.

requirement: Every page passes WCAG 2.2 AA checks
expected: axe-core (WCAG 2.0 to 2.2, A and AA) reports no violations on the pages each role reaches and in the states a tap opens, at 390 and 1366 px.
steps: Run both audit scripts.

requirement: Laria installs as an app
expected: On Android Chrome Laria can be installed; it opens without the browser's bar with the Laria icon and offers Vender un instrumento and Mis favoritos on a long press.
steps: Install from Chrome's menu, open it, long-press the icon.

requirement: Laria never asks to be installed
expected: No banner or dialog of Laria's own offers the install.
steps: Browse as a visitor.

requirement: Photos shared from the gallery open the listing form
expected: Sharing up to 10 photos to installed Laria opens the Particular form (the store's for a store owner) on the photo step with them, in order; signed out it asks to sign in first and the photos wait.
preconditions: Installed app; signed in and signed out.
steps: Share two photos from the gallery to Laria.

requirement: A shared photo is used once and never resurfaces
expected: The form takes the photos once and the device copy is deleted; a share older than a day is dropped; /compartir is never indexed.
preconditions: A share left unused for a day.
steps: Share, wait, open the form.

requirement: The service worker only handles shares and notices
expected: It is registered at /compartir/ in production builds; pages, images and data come from the network with or without it.
steps: Check the registration scope and the network panel after a deploy.

requirement: Notices are turned on per device, only from the switch
expected: Activar avisos in Notificaciones asks the browser's permission; nothing asks on a first visit; once on, the phone shows a sample notice.
steps: Open Notificaciones, press Activar avisos.

requirement: A push reads and opens like its notification
expected: One notice shows the same label and listing name as its row in Notificaciones and opens the same page; several pending become one message; the phone shows one Laria notice at a time.
preconditions: A device turned on; notices created.
steps: Run the worker; tap the notice.

requirement: No push at night
expected: From 22:00 to 08:00 Lima nothing is sent; those notices go out together in the morning.
preconditions: Worker run inside the quiet hours.
steps: Run the worker at 23:00 and at 08:05 Lima.

requirement: Read or old notices are not pushed
expected: A notice read in Laria, older than three days, or for someone with no device left is skipped, never sent.
steps: Run the worker.

requirement: Pushes go only to browser push services, for the device's owner
expected: A person reaches only their own devices; endpoints outside Google, Mozilla, Apple and Microsoft push services and malformed keys are refused; only the service role claims and finishes deliveries.
preconditions: Two accounts; signed out; service role.
steps: Run the SQL suite.

requirement: Shared phones and sign-out
expected: A device belongs to whoever turned notices on last; a person keeps ten devices at most; signing out turns that device off before the session ends.
steps: Turn notices on with A, then with B; sign out.

requirement: Failed sends retry and gone devices are forgotten
expected: A failed send retries after 5 min, 30 min, 2 h and 8 h, five attempts in all; a device the push service no longer knows, or one that failed five times in a row, is forgotten; a stopped worker's claim returns after 15 minutes.
steps: Run the SQL suite.

requirement: The push worker is protected and safe without keys
expected: The worker route needs CRON_SECRET; without VAPID keys it only logs what it would send.
preconditions: No VAPID keys; wrong and right secret.
steps: Call the route.

requirement: Messages are encrypted and signed to the standards
expected: Payloads are encrypted as RFC 8291 describes and signed with VAPID for the push service's origin.
steps: Run the unit tests.
